description: East Bay Insulation is an insulation contractor based in San Leandro, CA, with in-house crews serving East Bay homes within about 30 miles.
intro: East Bay Insulation is based in San Leandro and works in homes across the East Bay. We keep every job small and local on purpose: one in-house crew inspects, installs and follows up, so the people who quote your job are the people who do it.

paragraphs: Every job starts with a free inspection. We look at what is in the attic, the crawl space and the walls, take the moisture readings that matter in this climate, and write a fixed estimate before any work starts.
bullets: One in-house crew from inspection to follow-up
Free inspection with a written estimate
A follow-up visit to confirm the work held

paragraphs: We focus on the insulation problems East Bay homes actually have: damp crawl spaces, drafty attics, hot upstairs rooms and rodents in the insulation.
bullets: Spray foam for attics, rim joists and crawl spaces
Crawl space encapsulation and vapor barriers
Rodent proofing and exclusion before reinsulation
